plan: behind3 (game/probe/unit_probe.py BH3_*; tmp/melee_core/v2/review.md v2.1 CONSOLIDATED D, tmp/melee_core/v21/critic_review.md 7, tmp/melee_core/design_v21.md D)
what: behind2's lane (clanrats_0 E, fearless, attack our anvil A - Empire spearmen, morale kept - at a run from 200 m; our swordsmen B, morale kept) varied where melee core v2.1 assumes: att / att_h A attacks E at a walk at the go, B 20 m behind attacks at a run 8 s after A's flag / never; stand2 / stand2_h E never ordered, A 1.5 m off its front attacks at a walk, B on A's line 48 m aside attacks 20 s after A's flag / never; b24a B 30 m aside and 20 m behind a 24 m anvil, b24s B 60 m aside on its line (hold h24); two24 / two2 B 20 m and C 40 m straight behind a 24 / 30 m anvil (holds h24 / h30); b30p / h30p swordsmen anvil + halberdiers joiner on clanrat_spearmen_0; narrow B 15 m wide; packed B never ordered, its front 2 m inside A's back; q30 / q12 B killed to 30 / 12 men at placement. 19 battles in the night's priority (1-2 att, 3-4 stand2, 5-7 b24a, 8-11 two, 12-13 pair, 14-16 narrow / packed, 17-19 quarter), 6 (two: 5) lanes rotated over 6 places, B's side mirrored between battles, the clock lane; 20 units with the lords, <= 2402 men; 100 ms engine step wanted. Added before battle 20: three (B behind, C and D on A's line 48 m to each side, all at 8 s) x 3 a battle with one h30, battles 20-21 (20 units). Added before battle 22: place3 (p3f / p3m / p3r x 2 a battle), battles 22-24 (20 units).
measures: behind2's measures (behind2_game.json 'measures'): per-man rows from memory (A, B, C and E bound) every 0.1 s while B and E are within 105 m before the contact, every 0.5 s after it. A start: a living man present in two consecutive polls whose strike mark rose, given to the unit owning the man in his tgt at the later poll. In reach: a living enemy man within 4.0 m (centres). t: s from A's first melee flag; tau: s from the joiner's own first melee flag (two24 / two2: the earlier of B's and C's). A rate: starts over the polls' span in the window. x = 1 - E>A / hold's E>A, y = E>B / hold's E>A, tot = (E>A + E>B + E>C) / hold's E>A, vB = B's men in reach of E / hold's A men in reach, the hold = the mean of the kind's hold lanes (BH3_BASE: att_h, stand2_h, h24, h30, h30p) over the same seconds from their A flag; a lane enters a tau bin only if A and B have not routed and the lane ran to its end. Losses: unit_probe behind2_measure (health shares, windows 30 / 60 / 120 / 240 s from the sample before the lane's first flag); kind - hold paired by battle (mf_paired). Mean +- one standard error over lanes; 'within two errors of N (+- e)': |m - N| <= 2 sqrt(se^2 + e^2). Code: tmp/probe_night5/ext.py, series.py, tlib.py, tables.py (behind2's, with the new kinds).

L1_att.source: critic_review.md 7.1; review.md v2.1 CONSOLIDATED C (the attacking senior, (i'))
L1_att.measure: att (6 new lanes; the 2 of behind2 pooled beside, not deciding): x and vB at tau 105-225 s over att_h
L1_att.carry: x within two errors of 0.33 AND vB within two errors of 0.26 (the tables: no error on them) -> the tables carry for an attacking senior
L1_att.M: x >= 0.4 and vB >= 0.35 -> an attacking senior's junior becomes 'one line by men' after 105 s
L1_att.else: neither -> the row is reported as measured; the orchestrator decides
L1_att.rows_for_blocking: E_0_120 / E_0_240 and trade_120 / trade_240 of att minus att_h paired by battle (stated on 2 lanes: +0.020 +- 0.003 / +0.085 +- 0.011, trade +0.036 / +0.109); E's loss 30-240 s after A's flag in att over the same battle's att_h mean (unit rows; stated 1.11-1.17 on 2 lanes, the per-man recompute of those 2 lanes [1.144, 1.19]), and by second (30-60, 60-120, 120-240 s)
L1_att.note: behind2's 2 att lanes at tau 45-105: {'x': [0.284, 0.03, 2], 'y': [0.28, 0.019, 2], 'vB': [0.317, 0.028, 2]} (no lane reached 105-225: the lanes ran 240 s from A's flag; behind3's att lanes run 285 s after the contact)

L2_stand2.measure: stand2 (6) over stand2_h (6): x and y at tau 15-30 / 30-45 / 45-105 s (105-225 printed); E's health loss from B's flag to +60 / +120 s over the hold's over the same seconds from A's flag
L2_stand2.carry: x and y each within two errors of deep_front's at 45-105 s and in at least 2 of the 3 bins, and E's loss over hold at 0-120 within two errors of 1.260 +- 0.043 -> the tables carry for a standing enemy
L2_stand2.else: any of those outside -> a standing enemy gets its own row (the measured one)
L2_stand2.note: flank2v1's target is clanrats_1 with its morale and ours fearless; stand2's E clanrats_0 fearless and ours with their morale (behind2's units) - the difference is said beside the verdict

L3_b24a.source: design_v21.md D (the q blend; review.md CONSOLIDATED A.7: core_share.free_blend by this row, else OFF)
L3_b24a.measure: B's in-reach men (4 m of E) beyond the anvil's ends (|lateral in A's frame| > 12 m) at t 60-120 s, b24a (B 30 m aside, 20 m behind) and b24s (B 60 m aside on A's line), each 6 lanes
L3_b24a.stands: within two errors of b24's 10.4 -> the free-metres blend stands
L3_b24a.goes: under 5 -> HEAD's reach cut, the blend goes
L3_b24a.else: between -> reported; the blend stays OFF (review.md A.7: failing a row, OFF)

L4_two.measure: two24 / two2 (B 20 m and C 40 m straight behind a 24 / 30 m anvil, both at 8 s): E's total starts (E>A + E>B + E>C) at t 60-120 s over h24's / h30's E>A; x at tau 45-105 (tau from the earlier joiner)
L4_two.once: total inside 1.00-1.10 (within two errors of the interval and below 1.2 by more than two errors) -> free metres are taken once
L4_two.each: total within two errors of 1.2 and above 1.10 by more than two errors -> each junior its own

x_product.why: 1 - (1 - x_lone)^2 with x_lone behind2's b24 / b30 at tau 45-105 (the lone relief of a joiner straight behind the same anvil); error 2 (1 - x) se
x_product.line: x within two errors of the product -> the reliefs multiply; within two errors of x_lone -> the second junior adds no relief; else reported

L5_pair.measure: b30p (swordsmen anvil, halberdiers joiner, clanrat_spearmen_0 E fearless) over h30p: x and vB at tau 45-105 and 105-225 s
L5_pair.carry: x and vB within two errors of b30's in both bins -> the tables carry to another pair

L6_narrow_packed.packed: E>B over h30's E>A at t 60-120 s (B never ordered, its front 2 m inside A's back): above 0.1 by two errors -> the take needs no order; under 0.05 by two errors -> the take is gated on the junior's attack order; else reported

L7_quarter.measure: x at tau 45-105 of q30 (B 30 men) and q12 (12 men) over h30
L7_quarter.none: within two errors of b30's [0.291, 0.032, 14] -> no factor for size
L7_quarter.factor: under half of it by two errors -> a factor read from the two points (x_q / x_b30 at men 30 / 12 of 120)

L8_three.source: design_v21.md D (two juniors on one line, three juniors: R4's form); critic_review.md 7 item 7
L8_three.measure: three (B 20 m straight behind, C and D on A's line 48 m to each side, all at 8 s after A's flag; 6 lanes, battles 20-21) over h30: E's total starts (E>A + E>B + E>C + E>D) at t 60-120 s over h30's E>A; x at tau 45-105 s (tau from the earliest joiner)
L8_three.stands: total inside 1.00-1.10 (as L4) and x within two errors of the product of the lone reliefs 1 - (1 - x_b30)(1 - x_side)^2 = 0.61 +- 0.032 (behind2's b30 / side at tau 45-105) -> R4's form stands
L8_three.additive: x within two errors of the sum x_b30 + 2 x_side = 0.807 +- 0.06 -> additive
L8_three.note: added after battles 1-2 ran, before battles 20-21 (the plan's 'three' kind was built then); behind2_measure's losses carry the second extra (C) only - D's losses are read from the per-man series

L9_place3.source: design_v21.md D (rho along the flank; review.md CONSOLIDATED A.6: the taper waits for place3)
L9_place3.measure: p3f / p3m / p3r (6 lanes each, battles 22-24): B (swordsmen, facing as the lane's attacker) held with its inner edge 20 m off the flank E will have at the contact (E's centre then 200 m ahead of its start, its front on A's), its centre level with E's front third / middle / rear third (+-5.1 m: E 15.3 m deep), attacks E at a run 8 s after A's flag; x at tau 45-105 s over h30 (all h30 lanes of the night)
L9_place3.as_written: front >= 0.2 and rear <= 0.07 -> rho as written (the taper)
L9_place3.whole_flank: rear >= 0.2 -> rho 1 on the whole flank
L9_place3.note: added before battles 22-24 ran (built after battle 2); the twin places B by a_dx / gap_m (the same place, facing 180 as in the game's default)
